title: Python executor for the language-neutral pipeline spec
context: Much of the citizen-science ecosystem is Python/R, and the pipeline spec is deliberately language-neutral so a second executor can meet users where they live. This future-backlog task adds a Python executor for the same declarative spec, holding the same reproducibility invariant (byte-identical replay) as the TypeScript reference executor. The spec is already neutral, so this is additive.
objective: Implement a Python executor for the language-neutral pipeline spec that produces byte-identical output to the reference executor and emits the same run manifest.
acceptanceCriteria: Python executor runs the same declarative PipelineSpec as the TypeScript reference executor
Double-run byte-identical replay holds; output matches the reference executor for shared fixtures
Emits the same W3C-PROV-style run manifest format
Non-deterministic operations forbidden; tool versions pinned and recorded
output: A PR adding a Python executor for the pipeline spec with cross-executor reproducibility tests.
